messages:
Maria (CS): Hey team — Aurora Labs onboarding. After they ramp test to ~180 parallel preflight calls they start getting 429s from sdkgateway ~30s in. SDK: browser-js v1.4.2, using ephemeral tokens via preflight.

Ingrid (Eng): Do we have request IDs or route pattern? Is it the same model/route for the 429s?

Maria (CS): Log snippet: `429 {"error":"rate_limited","reason":"preflight_fanout"}`. Mostly /v1/embeddings, small fraction to /v1/streams. They spawn ~10 workers x 18 tabs during QA.

Sam (DevEx): Quick checks: are they debouncing token refresh? also make sure `x-client-id` or session header isn't different per tab. A lot of browser setups accidentally mint a token per mount. Add 100-250ms jitter on preflight.

Devon (CS): Customer reported "it works locally" but fails under parallel QA. They said they open multiple windows. Could be multiplier effect.

Ingrid (Eng): @TelemetryBot can you pull traces for tokens with prefix `aurora-` around 1780011100..1780011300 and show top errors?

TelemetryBot: Query run — burst window at 1780011204: ~220 requests in 10s for the same ephemeral token. 95% to embeddings route. Top error: 429 preflight_quota. Trace link: https://internal/trace/aurora/abc123 (internal).

Sam (DevEx): That confirms token reuse across many clients. If the token is minted per-tab, each tab multiplies the concurrency. Recommend server-side single token per session or debounce on client.

Maria (CS): They posted their refresh snippet: `fetch('/auth/refresh').then(r=>r.json())` called on every client mount. So yep, new token per mount.

Devon (CS): Short-term remediation: ask them to debounce refresh so one in-flight refresh per session. Long-term: recommend a token proxy in quickstart. I'll draft the message.

Ingrid (Eng): Also note: we enforce `preflight_concurrency` per token. We can raise a temporary exception for org_aurora_42 for embeddings only. If you want I can open a 72-hour bump to 300 concurrent. But we need their fix deployed.

Maria (CS): Org id is org_aurora_42. Please proceed with a temporary bump to 300 for embeddings. I'll push the debounce patch to them.

Ingrid (Eng): I'll open the exception now and record it in the org config. Opening ticket INF-7123, expiry +72h.

Sam (DevEx): Adding a sample debounce to the onboarding doc: ```js
let pending = null
function getToken(){
  if(pending) return pending
  pending = fetch('/auth/refresh').then(r=>r.json()).finally(()=> pending = null)
  return pending
}
```

Devon (CS): Sent the patch to Aurora, monitoring. If flapping continues I'll flag renewal risk, but asking them to deploy debounce first.

Maria (CS): Thanks everyone — I'll update the onboarding ticket with the exception id and the doc snippet. Follow-up check-in scheduled +24h. :thumbsup:
